URL: https://docs.crustdata.com/person-docs/quickstart

Summary: Person APIs = 3 indexed + 2 enterprise-locked live endpoints.

Indexed:
  /person/search                 Find people by filters
  /person/search/autocomplete    Discover valid filter values
  /person/enrich                 Get full profile from URL or email

Enterprise Live (locked):
  Live Search  🔒   /person/professional_network/search/live   "Search people in real time from the web"  — Book a demo
  Live Enrich  🔒   /person/professional_network/enrich/live   "Fetch fresh profile data from the web"     — Book a demo

Error codes:
  400, 401 all; 403 Search/Enrich; 404 Enrich (per spec); 500 all.

No-match behavior:
  Search: 200 profiles:[]
  Enrich: 200 matches:[]  (OpenAPI spec says 404, reality = 200 empty)
  Autocomplete: 200 suggestions:[]

Retry guidance:
  400/401/403/404 → No retry
  500 → Yes, exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s)

Key filter fields:
  Profile URL → professional_network_profile_urls (Enrich)
  Business email → business_emails (Enrich)
  Person name → basic_profile.name (Search, Autocomplete)
  Job title → experience.employment_details.current.title (Search, Autocomplete)
  Current company → experience.employment_details.current.company_name (Search, Autocomplete)
  Headline → basic_profile.headline (Search, Autocomplete)
  Location → basic_profile.location (Search)

Footguns:
  - key is "field", not "column"
  - one identifier type per Enrich
  - use full dot-path like experience.employment_details.current.title (not "current_title")
  - always specify fields in production Search
  - Enrich returns a top-level array, NOT { results: [...] }
